Package com.lognet.recordio.config

Class RecordIOAutoConfiguration

java.lang.Object
com.lognet.recordio.config.RecordIOAutoConfiguration
@AutoConfiguration @ConditionalOnWebApplication(type=SERVLET) @ConditionalOnProperty(prefix="recordio", name="enabled", havingValue="true", matchIfMissing=true) @EnableConfigurationProperties(RecordIOProperties.class) public class RecordIOAutoConfiguration extends Object
Auto-configuration for RecordIO.

This configuration is automatically applied when the starter is on the classpath and can be disabled by setting recordio.enabled=false.
